mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10Y-2Y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a -2% YoY drop in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point increase over the past 3 months, signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence (Conference Board index) rises by > 5 points during the signal period, indicating that the labor market deterioration is not impacting consumer behavior.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Real GDP growth accelerates by > 1% (QoQ annualized) during the signal period, indicating that the restrictive policy is not slowing the economy.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer sentiment (UMich survey) rises by > 5 points during the signal period, indicating that the demand weakness is not broadly based.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing PMI falls below 45, indicating a contraction in the manufacturing sector, and the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past 3 months, it signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The ISM manufacturing PMI rebounds above 50 during the signal period, indicating that the manufacturing contraction is temporary.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a high-inflation, low-interest-rate environment that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury yield rises by more than 50 basis points during the signal period, indicating that inflation expectations are becoming unanchored.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4% and payroll employment growth accelerates by more than 200,000 jobs per month over the past 3 months, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation and negatively impact corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Atlanta Fed's wage growth tracker decelerates by more than 1 percentage point during the signal period, indicating that the tight labor market is not leading to wage inflation.
